Michael / Priyom —

See answers below (concise, ready to forward to Ben with attachments). I also attached an internal runbook we use for air-gapped installs — it contains the offline bundle signing procedure, verification steps, and a template network diagram.

1) HSM/KMS integration
- Supported: Thales Luna (PKCS#11), Utimaco (PKCS#11), and AWS CloudHSM (gateway mode via KMIP).
- Modes: we support customer KMS for data-at-rest encryption keys and envelope encryption for model artifacts. Keys are never exported in cleartext; Redwood calls into the HSM for crypto operations using PKCS#11 or KMIP.
- Known limitations: hardware-enforced key caching differs by vendor; for low-latency inference we recommend a dedicated HSM pool or an enterprise gateway to avoid per-request HSM latency.

2) Offline patching and signed bundles
- We produce signed offline patch bundles (tar.gz + detached signature, RSA-4096) that can be delivered via removable media or SFTP into the customer maintenance node.
- Verification: appliance verifies signature, checks SBOM hash, and validates package expiry windows. We document rollback instructions.

3) SBOM & provenance
- We provide SPDX v2.2 SBOMs for all runtime components and a GPG-signed attestation that maps SBOM entries to build artifacts. We can also produce a reproducible build log on request.

4) Network egress and telemetry
- For private deployments we offer a strict zero-egress mode: the control plane and telemetry can be disabled; offline licensing via license server files is supported.
- Optional remote support: an outbound-only encrypted tunnel to our support broker can be enabled for root-cause analysis; it is established only with explicit customer consent and a short-lived certificate.

5) Support and on-call
- We provide a 24x7 enterprise on-call rotation for air-gapped deployments; severity SLAs and RTO/RPO are part of the Dedicated/Private contract. Emergency patch process is supported (signed emergency bundles).

Availability: I can join Thursday 2025-09-18 at 14:00 PDT for the deep dive. Priyom, can you confirm you can attend?
